title: People demonstrating an illuminated pixel sign
visual_facts: Two people lean over a small rectangular illuminated sign on a table.
The sign displays the word HELLO in bright white block letters.
A laptop is open immediately to the right of the sign.
The person at left wears a badge with the words ON DUTY.
A roll of black tape and other small objects sit on the table.
spatial_relations: The illuminated sign is between the two people and in front of the open laptop.
uncertainties: The electronics inside the sign and its control method are not visible.
Smaller badge text is not legible.
